## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security fix
- [ ] Dependency or compatibility update
- [ ] Other

## Testing

Describe how the change was tested, including relevant WordPress and PHP versions when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, personal data, or other secrets are included.
- [ ] Capability checks, nonces, validation, sanitization, and escaping remain appropriate.
- [ ] External requests remain consistent with the plugin's consent and privacy model.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated when behavior or configuration changed.
- [ ] I reviewed the change for backward-compatibility implications.
- [ ] I understand that contributions are distributed under the repository's applicable license terms.

## Security and privacy impact

Describe any impact on authentication, authorization, stored data, API credentials, external services, privacy, or security. Write `None` if there is no impact.
